definitions.full: H1417. gedud or gedudah II. [ גְּדוּד , or גְּדוּדָה ] noun [masculine or feminine] furrow , cutting — 1 furrow , plural defective גְּדוּדֶ֑הָ Psa 65:11 (|| תְּלָמֶיהָ ). 2 plural גְּדֻדֹת , cuttings upon hands, compare גדד Hithpo`el 2 sign of mourning Jer 48:37 (|| שׂק ).
